replay.title: Replay with today's agnts
replay.sub: Re-run this ticket from the commit it started from, with the current prompts, brief and rules, and compare the result with what you approved. The replay is never pushed.
replay.confirm: agnts creates a new task that re-does {key} from where it started. It uses your Claude plan like any ticket.
replay.banner: This is a replay to evaluate agnts: it is never pushed. Compare it with
replay.evalSub: Done tickets re-run with a newer agnts, compared with the change you approved. Start one with Replay on a done ticket, or `agnts eval replay KEY`.
replay.colOverlapHint: How much the replay's changed files match the approved change's (Jaccard index)
replay.colRecallHint: Share of the approved change's files the replay changed too
replay.benchmarkSub: Merged tickets that every change to agnts is replayed against, and scored against what they merged as. Pick 20–30 of different sizes.
replay.benchmarkIn: In the benchmark: changes to agnts are replayed against this ticket.
replay.benchmarkNeedsMerge: Only merged tickets can be in the benchmark: replays are scored against what they merged as.
replay.benchmarkConfirm: agnts replays the {n} benchmark tickets from where each started. They use your Claude plan like any ticket.
replay.benchmarkEmpty: The benchmark is empty. Open a merged ticket and press Add to benchmark.
replay.colLinesHint: Share of the lines the merged pull request added that the replay adds too; in brackets the same for agnts's original change. Higher is closer to what people shipped.
